independent_variable: EvidenceStrategy only: legacy context/route versus GC-aware context plus one bounded deterministic causal-scope replan guard.
shared_replan_filter: Deterministic novel-read filter: validate the complete typed replan, remove exact prior tool/version/argument fingerprints, recompile novel reads, and route all-repeated plans to graph handoff before dispatch.
held_constant: strict schemas and public cause taxonomy
input snapshot hash and observation window
typed Tool Gateway and read-only catalog
deterministic novel-read filter and all-repeated handoff
Evidence construction, persistence and deterministic Gate
execution_order: Alternate baseline/candidate order by frozen dataset index parity.
failure_rule: Retain every failure, handoff and unknown resource value. Never selectively rerun, delete or replace an outcome.
runtime_label_isolation: The pair runner has no evaluator-label parameter and never imports the labels path; labels enter only after both arms finish.

starting_observation.failure_class: schema-valid replans containing at least one exact prior read

acceptance.top3_noninferiority: Candidate Top-3 correct count must be no lower than baseline.
acceptance.safe_control_noninferiority: Candidate safe-control count must be no lower than baseline.
acceptance.evidence_integrity: Every cited Evidence and Artifact hash resolves within the same Incident.
acceptance.resource_noninferiority: Median duration and rate-card cost must remain within the frozen continuous margins.
acceptance.decision: Accept only when every criterion passes; otherwise revise on this development set without opening the FC4 holdout.

limitations: This is a strategy-development comparison and cannot substitute for the untouched adequately sized FC4 confirmatory holdout.
The deterministic rate-card cost is not actual provider billing.
Workflow duration is not human diagnosis time, active labor, recovery time or MTTR.
No confirmed historical incidents, human approvals, recovery execution or recurrence outcomes are present.
